title: The Public Service Studio
learning_focus: Persuasive and informational text, non-verbal cues, multimedia contribution, propaganda awareness, formal presentation.
story_premise: A studio must produce a public-service message for a regional celebration, but the first draft relies on fear and vague slogans.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Persuasive and informational text, non-verbal cues, multimedia contribution, propaganda awareness, formal presentation.
